shell_commands: grep -rn "accumulateUsage\|sums each field\|returns next when\|returns accumulated when\|returns undefined when both" specs/ adrs/ --include="*.md"

ls scripts/spec-links/ 2>/dev/null || echo "no scripts/spec-links"; find . -name "*.mjs" -path "*/spec-links/*" 2>/dev/null; ls .re-lint/ 2>/dev/null || ls re-lint/ 2>/dev/null || find . -name "require-spec-link*" 2>/dev/null | head -5
ls CHANGELOG* 2>/dev/null; cat CHANGELOG.md 2>/dev/null | head -30 || echo "no changelog"
cat package.json | python3 -c "import sys,json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(data.get('scripts', {}), indent=2))"
npm run spec:names 2>&1 && echo "---" && npx eslint --max-warnings 0 src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.test.ts src/orchestration/toolRoundUsage.acceptance.test.ts 2>&1
git add specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/toolRoundUsage.acceptance.test.ts CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && git status

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(orchestrator): repair stale spec anchors and fix duplicate code

- Repoint four shouldContinueToolLoop spec links from L11/L15/L19/L23
  to L33/L37/L41/L45 (line shift caused by accumulateUsage tests added
  in the previous round)
- Add four accumulateUsage spec statements in the architecture spec so
  those unit tests carry proper traceability
- Update config-hooks spec link to match shifted acceptance test lines
  and add the second acceptance test's link
- Extract FIRST_TOOL_ROUND constant to eliminate duplicate block in
  acceptance test (eslint no-duplicate-code)
- Add CHANGELOG entry for the summed-usage behaviour change

Fixes: eslint, spec-names, changelog CI failures

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1
git push origin HEAD 2>&1 && git status
